entities.name: Voska
entities.description: Red mage of the Dark Age on Dominaria who taught Jodah his first magic and was killed by the Church of Tal.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Voska's apprentice, who received the Reflecting Mirror and fled the Church of Tal.

entities.name: Reflecting Mirror
entities.description: Item Voska gave Jodah that let him keep his sanity during his immortal lifespan.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church that arrested Voska and later tried to lure Jodah back with a rumor.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: Church of Tal leader whose grip Jodah escaped.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: Captured by the Church while investigating Voska's disappearance.

events.summary: After the Church of Tal arrested Voska, he staged an escape with Jodah, letting Jodah flee Primata Delphine.
events.quote: Voska staged an escape with Jodah, allowing his apprentice to flee the grip of Primata Delphine

events.summary: Voska was found and shot full of crossbow bolts.
events.quote: Voska himself was found and shot full of crossbow bolts.

events.summary: The Church spread a rumor that Voska survived to lure Jodah back, and captured Sima instead.
events.quote: They instead captured Sima trying to investigate the matter of Voska's disappearance.

relations.note: Voska taught Jodah the first skills of magic.
relations.quote: Voska had a major influence in teaching the first skills of magic to Jodah
After being arrested by the Church of Tal
